propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently wastes all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time when generation.sign_manifest detects own_material fingerprint mismatch
The cancel mechanism must scope to own material only to avoid false positives on unrelated ticket writes (regression of bug d70a)
Cancel detection occurs at two between-pass seams (after finders batch before verify prompt, and after decide before coach prompt) via probe_cancel checking own_material_changed
A detected mid-run own-material change returns an unsigned INDETERMINATE cancelled-stale verdict and skips all recovery, signing, and sidecar emission paths
The cancel signal uses a ContextVar-scoped event token that reaches pooled workers via copy_context, allowing _chunk to short-circuit without I/O
No fetch, sync lock, or store-wide reads occur during the cancel probe; it uses only local_read_context and attest.current_material_fingerprint for a single-ticket light read
